title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page finishes the proof of a Proposition and its Corollary from the previous page. The setting is a group scheme M_{ρ,σ} with an embedding into G × T_ρ × N'_σ, given by x ↦ (Θ_G(x), Θ_ρ(x), Θ_σ(x)). Here:
- G is a linear group, apparently GL_2.
- T_ρ is a torus.
- N'_σ is a torus normaliser-type group.
- There are characters δ_G = det, δ_ρ, δ_σ, ε_σ.
- R_{ρ,σ} is a group containing G_m, with R_{ρ,σ} ≃ S'T_ρ × SN'_σ.
- SG is the special group, and G^+_{ρ,σ} = SG.

The Corollary claims two things. First, (Θ_G, Θ_ρ, Θ_σ) is a monomorphism. Second, its image is the set of triples (U, a, b) with δ_G(U) = δ_σ(b) and (δ_ρ(a)/δ_σ(b))^2 = 1.

Injectivity was done on the previous page. The kernel of (Θ_G, χ, ε_2, ε_3) is SR°_{ρ,σ} ≃ ST_ρ × ST_σ, on which Θ_ρ and Θ_σ are the two projections.

This page proves surjectivity onto the subfunctor cut out by (20)/(22).
1. Given (U, a, b), set μ = det U. Work locally (fppf, after adjoining a square root) so that some λ satisfies λ^2 = μ.
2. Use the multiplication map Θ_{M̃}: M̃_{ρ,σ} := R_{ρ,σ} × SG → G, (r, U_0) ↦ k(r)U_0. Writing U = k(r)U_0 with U_0 ∈ SG forces k(r)^2 = det U = μ. This uses det(k(r)U_0) = k(r)^2, so in effect n = 2.
3. Take r to be the image of λ under the section G_m ↪ R_{ρ,σ}, so k(r) = λ.
4. Correct the triple by this central element: U_0 = λ^{-1}U, a_0 = λ^{-1}a, b_0 = λ^{-1}b. It then suffices to show (U_0, a_0, b_0) lies in the image.
5. Since U_0 ∈ SG, this reduces to showing (a_0, b_0) lies in the image of R_{ρ,σ} → T_ρ × N'_σ. After normalisation a_0 ∈ S'T_ρ and b_0 ∈ SN'_σ. Because R_{ρ,σ} ≃ S'T_ρ × SN'_σ, the claim follows.

Remark: G cannot be replaced by PG. The map M_{ρ,σ} → PG × T_ρ × N'_σ (even with G_m × μ_n × μ_n added) is not a monomorphism. Its kernel is exactly the central μ_n in G^+_{ρ,σ} = SG.

All of this is bookkeeping for the parametrisation (U, a, b; μ, ε, ε') of solutions in the 'équation des lacets' computations. The next page continues by feeding these quantities into the variables u, f, α, β of the earlier sections (§46, §48), which concern the Teichmüller/Galois tower in the Longue Marche.
errors: The existence of λ with λ^2 = μ holds only locally (fppf/étale after adjoining a square root). The text says 'on est ramené à la forme équivalente … qui a un λ' without spelling out the descent step; this is harmless for a statement about images of sheaves.

The step k(r)^2 = det U for U = k(r)U_0 with U_0 ∈ SG presupposes that G is GL_2 (det of a scalar is its square). Yet the closing Remark speaks of μ_n. Either the argument is specific to n = 2 or the notation is mixed; for n = 2, μ_n = μ_2.
The machine transcription duplicates a line in the Remark ('morphe G_m × μ_n × μ_n si on veut! n'est pas mono-').

ideas.what: Describing the image of a monomorphism of group schemes into G × T_ρ × N'_σ by character equations, with surjectivity proved by fppf-locally extracting a square root of det and correcting by a central G_m section.
ideas.modern_name: Image of a monomorphism of group schemes; fppf-local surjectivity via square-root extraction (μ_2-torsor / Kummer argument)
ideas.where_published: Technique of SGA3 type; this specific group M_{ρ,σ} appears only in the unpublished 'Longue Marche' sequel notes as far as known

ideas.what: Failure of injectivity after passing to the projective group PG: the kernel is the central μ_n ⊂ SG.
ideas.modern_name: Central isogeny SL_n → PGL_n with kernel μ_n

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine verification step (injectivity plus fppf-local surjectivity) inside long computational notes on the 'équation des lacets'. There is no new idea beyond standard group-scheme bookkeeping.
transcription_corrections: 'Coulhain[?] [-OPS-]' is likely 'conditions' (the crossed-out word may be 'OPS' or 'fppf'). The sense is: reduce to the equivalent form of the conditions where a λ with λ^2 = μ exists, i.e. after local extraction of a square root.
The NB in the margin probably reads 'NB Θ_{M̃} l'homom. M̃_{ρ,σ} =df R_{ρ,σ} × SG → G que je note aussi Θ_G' rather than 'que je savoir'.
'(car étant des "corrigés" (U, a, b) par l'image …)' should read 'car étant les "corrigés" de (U, a, b) par l'image dans G × T_ρ × T_σ de la section λ de G_m ↪ R_{ρ,σ}'.
'ses noyaux est' should be 'son noyau est'.
The Remark line 'morphe G_m × μ_n × μ_n si on veut! n'est pas mono-' is a duplication in the transcription and should be deleted.
The page number at top reads '537' (Grothendieck's pagination); the archive page is 468.
